title: CLI Serving Tools
summary: This module provides command-line interface tools for serving Hugging Face Transformer models via an API, including features like continuous batching, quantization, and dynamic model management.

nodes.label: CLI Server Entry Point
nodes.title: Serve CLI
nodes.description: The main command-line interface for starting the model serving API. It parses arguments and orchestrates the server setup and lifecycle.

nodes.label: Manage Model Loading
nodes.title: Model Manager
nodes.description: Handles the dynamic loading, unloading, and management of Transformer models based on requests and configuration, including device and quantization settings.

nodes.label: Configure Generation
nodes.title: Generation State
nodes.description: Manages inference generation parameters such as continuous batching, `torch.compile` usage, and other performance-related settings for model inference.

nodes.label: Handle Chat Completions
nodes.title: Chat Completion Handler
nodes.description: Processes API requests for chat-based text generation, interacting with the model manager and generation state to produce responses.

nodes.label: Handle Text Completions
nodes.title: Text Completion Handler
nodes.description: Processes API requests for general text completion, interacting with the model manager and generation state to fulfill requests.

nodes.label: Handle Model Responses
nodes.title: Response Handler
nodes.description: Manages general model response generation, providing a flexible interface for various model outputs beyond specific chat or text completions.

nodes.label: Handle Audio Transcription
nodes.title: Transcription Handler
nodes.description: Processes API requests for audio-to-text transcription, utilizing appropriate models managed by the system for speech recognition tasks.

nodes.label: Run HTTP Server
nodes.title: Uvicorn Server
nodes.description: An external ASGI web server (Uvicorn) that hosts the API endpoints, handles incoming HTTP requests, and routes them to the appropriate handlers.

groups.label: Surface Components
